topic: User creation and client association issue
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed an issue where a newly created user account, associated with [email@jcdecaux.com], was not correctly linked or visible under the client's profile. The user reported difficulty understanding why this process had stopped working properly.
[me] confirmed that the user account was successfully created but noted it was not attached to the company/client record. A temporary username, 'flibusta540', was provided.
decisions: The user account was created and a temporary identifier ('flibusta540') was shared.
